work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXXIX accepts the Fukien vicar’s renunciation of Chekiang and Kiangsi and erects them into a vicariate apostolic; LF39536 → LF39542 across page number 269 LF39539; complete 14 August 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF39523–39523; the source closing at LF39580–39583 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo oc- tavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
